name: Conrad Osaka
positioning: High-rise hotel in Nakanoshima Festival Tower West in central Osaka, built around the concept 'Your Address in the Sky', with views over the city from every room
best_for: Travelers who want a central Osaka base with direct Metro access
Guests who want sweeping city views from their room and from the spa

facts.text: The hotel's concept is 'Your Address in the Sky'.
The hotel is directly connected to an Osaka Metro station.
Umeda and Namba are within walking distance of the hotel.
Kyoto is 15 minutes from Shin-Osaka by shinkansen.
The interior design incorporates natural phenomena such as wind and light.
Conrad Spa takes the power of stones as its theme.
Conrad Spa offers Sisley treatments in collaboration with the French cosmetics brand Sisley.
Daily wellness activities are offered for hotel guests.
The Conrad Junior family plan includes a kids' tent in the room and use of the pool facilities.
The banquet rooms are pillarless with floor-to-ceiling windows.

highlights.text: All guest rooms, restaurants, banquet rooms, the spa and fitness area, the indoor pool and meeting rooms look out over Osaka's skyline, rivers, the sea and distant mountains.
The 40th-floor lobby is welcomed by Fu/Rai's signature artwork inspired by Fujin and Raijin, the wind and thunder gods.
The spa has private treatment rooms, a jet bath and a couples spa, with views of the city.
The hotel is in Nakanoshima Festival Tower West, with art, museums and concert halls adjacent.

considerations.text: Parking is available, with limited spaces.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
